dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You must learn to obey the rules. Or next time, this will be you.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: …No, just kill me at least!

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: Silence now.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What did you just do?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: What had to be done.

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: Fools never learn.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Lacra! No!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: You know what awaits them? A slow and horrifying death. A death I wouldn't wish on my worst enemies.

dialogue.speaker: Yanna
dialogue.line: You must run... He's... close... Run!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yanna? Oh God!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q301_woman
dialogue.line: Help me... Please, help me...

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Spare us your drivel. You left me no choice.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You’re fine now. It’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Yanna
dialogue.line: Coen! Oh, God… it’s really you…

dialogue.speaker: Pieter
dialogue.line: Where is Lunka?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [untintelligible words]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [snort]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [snort] Of course – I live here. He's Svartrau's patron saint.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What the hell happened? An uriash didn't climb up here to fight, that's for sure...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.103_robber
dialogue.line: I don't remember letting you come in here, lad.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.103.citizen.01
dialogue.line: Go back to sleep, Mara, we can't do nothing about anything...

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Was I supposed to sit here in the stench wafting off the goat's corpse? Don't be ridiculous.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.103.citizen.02
dialogue.line: What the Devil? Is... is someone on the roof again?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You're actually incapable of focusing on the road in front of you, aren't you?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You think Brencis is behind this?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: This isn't a conversation.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: 6FEFF07D41345EFFEAD50BB88216995E
dialogue.line: What are you doing to him?

dialogue.speaker: 8D6F4AB34BB29137B45F86866CFE0298
dialogue.line: Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Your actual point, please?

dialogue.speaker: B3EC901D4584E22A5EEDD8BBD49C87F1
dialogue.line: Ambrus knew about you.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You know Vicho, don't you?

dialogue.speaker: 72EAC9A64ECEF181E1909782CFC007F0
dialogue.line: Bakir's uriashi talk about you.

dialogue.speaker: AFE303404AA16F6979378BAA0894911B
dialogue.line: Do you know Vicho?

dialogue.speaker: 266E68404DD38053BE8FC2933C0A0A84
dialogue.line: Guess you need better sources.

dialogue.speaker: 1827818447D6151FD48CE2BE78469692
dialogue.line: I did not.

dialogue.speaker: B26C4CD041199399981405A978FDAEB6
dialogue.line: I don't trust you with that.

dialogue.speaker: 2567E0F14EA19D2AB42E5CBA0A28D121
dialogue.line: I have friends over there.

dialogue.speaker: FEBAA2E042D92AE3ADCEE0B23E63C1AB
dialogue.line: I have my ways.

dialogue.speaker: 8AD04F05412A547C65B7D8A4ED7046A5
dialogue.line: I haven't been one for long.

dialogue.speaker: AB93262B405A9FD3606C44A1E10A51AD
dialogue.line: I heard from a friend there was a mysterious vrakhir around.

dialogue.speaker: 28D9ED064AC57F6F07960BAF600ED131
dialogue.line: I know where the village is.

dialogue.speaker: D053BC5C4BD2F53A9CC99A96D80F1C9C
dialogue.line: I know where the village is.

dialogue.speaker: 3AD066B94626883F533F47BAF1E46868
dialogue.line: I spotted signs of a struggle nearby.

dialogue.speaker: 7E439493407731C129B58EBD25733AA8
dialogue.line: I'll find another way, I'm out.

dialogue.speaker: F4EB400C48FEDE0A4358DC8FD69BB425
dialogue.line: I'll find another way, I'm out.

dialogue.speaker: 204B89494F70F8DE52C632A85483E6F3
dialogue.line: I'll mark it on your map, if you have one.

dialogue.speaker: D52FC1814820D1A274B501B9A89BDF96
dialogue.line: I'm a dawnwalker, not a vrakhir.

dialogue.speaker: 9CAE8F73475A27528F47F4B3F6ECE95F
dialogue.line: I've been turned recently. I'm quite lost.

dialogue.speaker: 7EFFC1B54F88E6192D1F5AA092CF454E
dialogue.line: It's a no from me.

dialogue.speaker: 90D0094D4F0C1B9062464AACC7549B50
dialogue.line: Just stumbled upon it.

dialogue.speaker: 950EC41C4393BA23EBE5BDA52D69C863
dialogue.line: Let the uriash go.

dialogue.speaker: 15EF18E2490538401D8026ABDCF8011E
dialogue.line: No, release him.

dialogue.speaker: 26054C024101EFADE75C1598B25A80A9
dialogue.line: The uriash is going free.

dialogue.speaker: C39074674156E9F253411CBD6F6B8CDE
dialogue.line: The uriash is going free.

dialogue.speaker: D21005A7484BA43152BE78859A32FA4F
dialogue.line: What did you want from Xanthe?

dialogue.speaker: 90DFFA8442242B2DBB7BB5BBE3F89456
dialogue.line: What is Brencis's weak spot?

dialogue.speaker: DB3F16DC463C6042F2558EBCC3371673
dialogue.line: What is this place?

dialogue.speaker: A4B117984925D33100F7A69061281635
dialogue.line: What's going on between you and the uriash?

dialogue.speaker: 7DD1D668467793D30B31F7A3B9EA2FE9
dialogue.line: Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: 801BEDE94268B4A0689BD794BDE7AAC4
dialogue.line: You think Isbrand would help us?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Did you speak with Isbrand?

dialogue.speaker: Matriarch
dialogue.line: Where he go? Pig head come for talk, but now stray!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You know what? Forget him. Tell me where Isbrand is.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q103_nish
dialogue.line: [spit]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh] All right. I've tried. I'm sorry, but the stakes are too high.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: What? You were serious there, with all the bonding?

dialogue.speaker: 38D97A1D46BE4DBA9797DBA9D57C64EE
dialogue.line: All right.

dialogue.speaker: C144B6534E023624609D9987406A4C2A
dialogue.line: All right. I've tried.

dialogue.speaker: 65106E55422BEA7B9A78949AD9668FDA
dialogue.line: Brencis is our common enemy.

dialogue.speaker: 39A58F8C424D89B43269448071926680
dialogue.line: Can the Elder meet us somewhere else?

dialogue.speaker: C00FD7D34376BDBF7D663A85689C4B19
dialogue.line: I can talk to your corpse.

dialogue.speaker: 3D6D6BA74FFCD5ADC4E408AF05BB61E2
dialogue.line: I cannot let this go, because of my family.

dialogue.speaker: 93ACDCA345069F411B2DB393634DA98B
dialogue.line: I have my ways.

dialogue.speaker: 190BAEDD417B8CF4D092E8ABFE0D52AD
dialogue.line: I need to know how to get to your village.

dialogue.speaker: BAA307204299BD251B9599BB5C05DE43
dialogue.line: I'll do my best.

dialogue.speaker: 962E511741B03032C51EDF9B8AF3849C
dialogue.line: I'll try, but I can't promise you that.

dialogue.speaker: E7E9960A44682AC03F87B397F8EBEFA1
dialogue.line: I'm not a regular vrakhir.

dialogue.speaker: C314D4C645379F7A1CD74EA782130693
dialogue.line: Is it your choice to make?

dialogue.speaker: 9A4D680A4DAE776BBB5719A5E0B3FBE3
dialogue.line: Just speak up.

dialogue.speaker: 53F6FF9C43705E405880398C3A92E632
dialogue.line: Lacra, that's not necessary.

dialogue.speaker: 394D83F94CAF412BF9DE07A17AB350B4
dialogue.line: No, Lacra, I got this.

dialogue.speaker: 711368044C64E032DCEB1D8962A1C150
dialogue.line: Tell me or she interrogates you again.

dialogue.speaker: 54D573994A8489E809CA91A09657D8D0
dialogue.line: That's not my problem.

dialogue.speaker: 96DE3F694A8E060AA13D638EE4FED607
dialogue.line: We'll find the village on our own.

dialogue.speaker: 50483F6F4C417122BC2316BDCEBD7450
dialogue.line: What did he do to you?

dialogue.speaker: CA1D188D49B82FACC46245A25287F0F2
dialogue.line: Why do you refuse to help your kin?

dialogue.speaker: 860D6F30413A11D99ACD1A9751465120
dialogue.line: You act like Brencis's slave.

dialogue.speaker: 75F14BA84E847D06E9B8A8A52B28A8EE
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: B2E4354246B942532601ECA546A7885F
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: There you are. Let's finish this.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Still good?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You're out? And you expect to do anything about Brencis with this attitude?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You killed him, didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: 1CD5C4D442CB0D3B1CE28D80E878C3DE
dialogue.line: Can we meet there?

dialogue.speaker: 7E3DBDC44FFDC83CB2B6FD862460D31B
dialogue.line: He refused to tell you?

dialogue.speaker: 087B67F940F52FE107B19B8B66832E5A
dialogue.line: I can use a hex.

dialogue.speaker: 9071B304492A3EE1DBF3C487939A2F60
dialogue.line: I don't know. Any ideas?

dialogue.speaker: 13F556134E43BC15C3ECEF9180F81FFB
dialogue.line: I have my ways.

dialogue.speaker: AEB086CD4BCBD404216CE2822DBAD162
dialogue.line: I'm not a regular vrakhir.

dialogue.speaker: CDD106F244A49CB1376DAAB19501517F
dialogue.line: It's worth a shot.

dialogue.speaker: FE613EF747EC30CF86B80A8D66D5D5B8
dialogue.line: Just making sure you're still around.

dialogue.speaker: 937E2D6F40F1660858095AA608EC53AE
dialogue.line: There is a way I could talk to him still.

dialogue.speaker: B76288FF461918F18F9F538ACEBD97AB
dialogue.line: This is all too much, I'm out.

dialogue.speaker: C65E11E44C2AC561B88F399D5F93FF48
dialogue.line: Why does it take me over like that?

dialogue.speaker: F2C4A7914FD123A77F0BAB9912318273
dialogue.line: You've killed Nish, didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: Matriarch
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Tell me where Isbrand is and we may yet resolve this peacefully.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You're like a child who needs rearing, I swear. I told you where I'd be waiting for you, didn't I?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: The air seems thick with the smell of their blood...

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You're having a laugh, surely?

dialogue.speaker: 9D2A46AE4B06F3E0D9A02F84E919DB9F
dialogue.line: Can't you do that?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Still a no.

dialogue.speaker: 4C8B256E4DFF8AFE022F7C8D41A4D5D7
dialogue.line: How do you know all that?

dialogue.speaker: CD9BE6EF49582EAC13FA0586BB941CEF
dialogue.line: Hunt a person? Absolutely not.

dialogue.speaker: 66941B9847B38049105733B913586E6F
dialogue.line: I'm just like that. I don't know.

dialogue.speaker: CD2D21B140E35BA522AD909583DB4833
dialogue.line: Still a no.

dialogue.speaker: F34391A24E69DF4E1B9D98B261B1D735
dialogue.line: Still a no.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You seem quite familiar with their habits.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You try something, we'll find out how a roast kobold dinner smells. You hear me?

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: Wrrrongs! Grrr! Ha!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You can't tell me it wasn't a worthwhile detour...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're right. Positively rejuvenating. Come on, we have a mountain to climb.

dialogue.speaker: 94C2B5864BB5EEDE51D484A09DC82ECF
dialogue.line: I feel filthy.

dialogue.speaker: DD4C79314ACC9B0BE57958A9017A028E
dialogue.line: You could've joined in.

dialogue.speaker: 454168B74FB8D62A157F78B295AD440F
dialogue.line: You snooze you lose.

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: [sniff] Dead Wrongs! Silly, silly! Yes, yes! We eat! [panting]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Oh, a dinner invitation, is it?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You don't want it to come to that, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You've seen vrakhiri fight, no doubt. What do you want to risk your people's lives for?

dialogue.speaker: 982809C541D271EDD8359B8CB5A69BC8
dialogue.line: Bakr-Nish trusted us, you should too.

dialogue.speaker: UriashGuard
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Matriarch
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: 0F8A14924C5C2BBA5819F0B962072A73
dialogue.line: Everyone shut up for a second!

dialogue.speaker: 32967E1F4E6D0272AA3FF08367D51525
dialogue.line: I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: C63D5FFA4CA1803827979BAD8AED7785
dialogue.line: I told you to stand down, Lacra!

dialogue.speaker: D761018D49B1A8616D763C82C7A1E439
dialogue.line: Or we could just talk and not waste time?

dialogue.speaker: 9103FA7E4DB5B34425E59091E9BEC64B
dialogue.line: We can help your village.

dialogue.speaker: E4908E494461DB521BBCDF83AE7079C1
dialogue.line: We can help your village.

dialogue.speaker: A2C87B4D4292AD0DEEA653AD50FD5414
dialogue.line: We're not your prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: 4F57208B42FE98DA8A88C2A3B30C654F
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: Wrong! They want wrong! Break all! Grr, grr!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [snort]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yeah, looks just like you.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [do nothing]

dialogue.speaker: 5CB66CCA416E275253A75893E4E3AF7E
dialogue.line: All right, enough.

dialogue.speaker: Matriarch
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: A1CD56B046870A02143B52986A29F76C
dialogue.line: Can we stop with the hostilities?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [snort]

dialogue.speaker: ADE5821B4CE7024F6393B8BFAC81D9E7
dialogue.line: Enough!

dialogue.speaker: 62DA0AE747AAEADDE582BEA760C36894
dialogue.line: I didn't want it. But now I do.

dialogue.speaker: 34418A0347277CF1B69EEDA7ACFC9175
dialogue.line: I'm starting to wonder.

dialogue.speaker: BB571C1046B4F535DF05028BCD32C540
dialogue.line: Just don't hit her.

dialogue.speaker: F8E72EEF4A354863168B93816BDD75C2
dialogue.line: Okay, enough.

dialogue.speaker: 94CD07BC4ED4DAB8C14AF387BD6D4B70
dialogue.line: Throw one more and you'll regret it.

dialogue.speaker: 2B3F95E14126B3396F0B1CB4FAD4532C
dialogue.line: We've wasted enough time!

dialogue.speaker: 4C911A4D459E55062F28AE98AC98094B
dialogue.line: What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: 4666A72442CF7BC45D0A8F8DB6F865F9
dialogue.line: What's wrong with you?

dialogue.speaker: B1D5E9AE48820A0055E311AD682C47A4
dialogue.line: You are ridiculous.

dialogue.speaker: 1976148B4E4C02E4CE60D89BE1775C8E
dialogue.line: You're right, Lacra. I've had it, too.

dialogue.speaker: A7F7A0E4439F53881E61FA9FE5940D42
dialogue.line: You're right, Lacra. I've had it, too.

dialogue.speaker: F297B367420E2E1911CB479FC5A7A331
dialogue.line: You're right, Lacra. I've had it, too.

dialogue.speaker: D9E1EBC949519D3D2CF15DBCD5C6C9AC
dialogue.line: Your way it is, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: UriashGuard
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Matriarch
dialogue.line: You welcome in village if return. But only alone.

dialogue.speaker: 187B2FA54990EAC3B9049FBEE1FA372B
dialogue.line: Do you know why they fought?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why do you kill travellers in the mountains?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yes, I'm sure. Save your threats for someone who cares.

dialogue.speaker: 205D36B2443A2EB6740DD7BB9A66C91A
dialogue.line: Whatever, tell me what I need to know.

dialogue.speaker: 727791B44D917F31B1AC40A34E79A08C
dialogue.line: Why do you kill travellers in the mountains?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You speak as if it's guaranteed there is another way.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're vile.

dialogue.speaker: A89C7EEA4404274BD00BE8A2BD0F7608
dialogue.line: I want nothing to do with you. You're vile.

dialogue.speaker: B42A533345DA9633902A97949F8CFC5B
dialogue.line: I want nothing to do with you. You're vile.

dialogue.speaker: C28049514DD775FB900BD28D1600A836
dialogue.line: I'll find another way.

dialogue.speaker: 40C6751A409A27E6B7C85BA103D80DE4
dialogue.line: Oh, but I do.

dialogue.speaker: 8A3BE35A4EAFE922EF2B4C9E592D3507
dialogue.line: There surely was another way.

dialogue.speaker: FB44D57142572E63D6BBE08BE2A2C65F
dialogue.line: What the hell was your plan here?

dialogue.speaker: 79325E74473E79023A634CA96405AEBE
dialogue.line: Why did you go without me?

dialogue.speaker: FC3D8E6044D9E833858F9796F70E2E94
dialogue.line: You know where Isbrand is?

dialogue.speaker: F0EEB51049BD9A8FE654A1B2AA9FDD74
dialogue.line: You slaughtered the entire village. You revolt me.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You tell me that and we will leave. You stay stubborn - I break down the doors to your houses.

dialogue.speaker: Matriarch
dialogue.line: Leave village now... demons.

dialogue.speaker: 41E8777D486D78E424B4CABE12BECE11
dialogue.line: Feels like the bloodshed was unnecessary.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're a monster. I'm not going.

dialogue.speaker: 930FDAF8419EC97774D22C9BE82DB50D
dialogue.line: Let's proceed.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Time to go? Or want to loiter some more?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Time to go.

dialogue.speaker: E88D18DE413E9C80D4A0D1A4AF207D86
dialogue.line: I will loiter a little bit more.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're showing off.

dialogue.speaker: 8A0DD094497FE0E1C5A761B488FC2ECA
dialogue.line: Brother-in-blood? You mean we're related?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [snort] No, Coen, it's just a figure of speech. We share nothing but hatred for our maker.

dialogue.speaker: DEBABC054A5E0AFDCA0620B0C32275D2
dialogue.line: Can't Isbrand do that too?

dialogue.speaker: 2C8E32EF4AAF7FA1DDB0D0820B4F9F29
dialogue.line: Complicated history with Isbrand?

dialogue.speaker: 49C4B7D14DABCD71937EADA68BBAF8B9
dialogue.line: How well did you know Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: 0A6CA5114C8E5FD09AD5699F71949D37
dialogue.line: Not really.

dialogue.speaker: 989804DD4049932484CCDD91F1014114
dialogue.line: Well, that solves it.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You and me both.

dialogue.speaker: 291B00F8460A1A00BF96F19AFFBCB110
dialogue.line: Are you sure Isbrand can help us?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What kind of a creature even was this?

dialogue.speaker: 6AA518E64FA1D8D9D74A91A94E4DFB0D
dialogue.line: Brencis could've put it here.

dialogue.speaker: 21E3E0F84C3C693A3A61BEB09F2E6BC0
dialogue.line: Do you have any idea where it came from?

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: You smell tasty! We try eat! Try, try! But fail...

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [snort] You're joking, surely?

dialogue.speaker: D272C0214C6B52C3C583CC8DE80FD352
dialogue.line: But do we live as well?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You will show us where Isbrand is?

dialogue.speaker: 35135B05404A413127CFB88F4CAC8DD2
dialogue.line: Exactly!

dialogue.speaker: B052EDC044AC1FA9609A0C9D8EB7B0FB
dialogue.line: I stand by what I said. No deal.

dialogue.speaker: FDA5AE414C3FB39106D187A82CB83CC5
dialogue.line: We can help.

dialogue.speaker: 61A75ABC4DE607C34002348B936D3AB7
dialogue.line: We're fine on our own, as you can see.

dialogue.speaker: 3FD0E88D46A488C942FE9CAD916AE618
dialogue.line: Where is Isbrand?

dialogue.speaker: 94A2E54B4B11EC11B4916581DDECEBE0
dialogue.line: Why would we ever trust you?

dialogue.speaker: 2E9B746849397AC03DE0718F67482A24
dialogue.line: Wrongs? Chonk?

dialogue.speaker: A358B69545D65C691563B8848194B75E
dialogue.line: You kept attacking us...

dialogue.speaker: 22B2F1DE4DCA1EC88A82AA934B2FA32B
dialogue.line: You're right, let's find the way on our own.

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: Vrakhiri no hide! Vrakhiri fight! Yes, yes!!! Look! There! Ready!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah... I guess we should...

dialogue.speaker: 08F1AD73404BA00D6C7EC0966DDF7CC5
dialogue.line: Is he conscious?

dialogue.speaker: A068D94C4E3763C085FD23A65D61E5BB
dialogue.line: What's on your mind?

q103_14_hive_defeated: These moronic creatures, for fuck's sake...

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: Wrongs still in cave! Must kill! Yes, yes!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Oof, the big fuckers were 'you' before, you realise that, right?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh] You're too stupid to talk to. We're done wasting time here.

dialogue.speaker: 7491F02E459EFF608FC2BABCC203A758
dialogue.line: One step and you're just as dead.

dialogue.speaker: AA34E81C413FB68D07AF02A831589167
dialogue.line: You said it wasn't a trap.

dialogue.speaker: DFF9A83144729ECD88959DA6878E6DAE
dialogue.line: You want to die? Go ahead, we'll help.

dialogue.speaker: 232D59094279C2AA83F9A3AE9380D987
dialogue.line: You will lose your bond if you eat it.

dialogue.speaker: 27A2AB144D21BCF31EB92C9B15091E90
dialogue.line: You're too stupid to talk to.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Let's. Where are we taking him?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [scoff] Yeah. But to sever their mental bond and turn them into those 'Wrongs'... I'm almost glad to have seen it.

dialogue.speaker: CB7DD90D4E218048B10DE9A3502FB396
dialogue.line: Just a moment.

dialogue.speaker: 2EBBFC5643B647D85D5F3DB66DC87009
dialogue.line: And if you don't?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yes?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: 0AF8EC2A454F682D99722AACBE094E72
dialogue.line: Are you afraid of being trapped this way?

dialogue.speaker: 2487C70847B8810D234B6B824060288D
dialogue.line: It feels like it's personal to you.

dialogue.speaker: 0C8930BE4F3740834A2BEB835920C1FB
dialogue.line: Then I'll see you soon.

dialogue.speaker: 0357080B463C701CDE4D5784D86B2E2B
dialogue.line: What is this place?

dialogue.speaker: AB48D9974424CCB550BF8D9D9FB36253
dialogue.line: Are you worried about him?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Whatever became of Isbrand, his arrival was a big event for the kobold hive.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You’re worried about him? What they'd done to him?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yes. And I've never seen it happen before. Not with any sentient creature other than humans. I didn't think it was possible.

dialogue.speaker: 99CCEE4144594668F8EB859709CC0ECC
dialogue.line: Have you ever made a murohn?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You've mentioned murohni before – what are they?

dialogue.speaker: 5E50A7AF49D7FECCDA1F83BDE458104A
dialogue.line: What are murohni?

dialogue.speaker: A955E6A04F5C382CEE763D8AA39905EF
dialogue.line: You mentioned plants?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [exhale] It's funny. I used to ask myself that very question. And then, at some point, I think I forgot to.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You would've tortured him to death!

dialogue.speaker: BB4832E84B24D05F375FAEBC56D076E4
dialogue.line: I invite you in.

dialogue.speaker: A251C5214718E11A3C1123B47622B4BD
dialogue.line: I'll invite you in.

dialogue.speaker: FDB0E0B2415E47B857D1C6B7735D3233
dialogue.line: I'm sorry. You left me no choice.

dialogue.speaker: 639A2B4A496300F01C7402B085B85109
dialogue.line: What choice do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: B52329544F7EF31067C4D79CA82F5978
dialogue.line: What did you fail at?

dialogue.speaker: 9B3BEAEA402CF46737303C96A74CD2C4
dialogue.line: Where is the line, Lacra?

dialogue.speaker: 2B7F2B224BC94161EDD33BB8BF1CAA58
dialogue.line: Would you do it for me?

dialogue.speaker: B45CCAA44CC01C26A74A1BA66B5F627B
dialogue.line: You deserve to stay here for the village.

dialogue.speaker: 1B58A57D4F931EE2F1CC7F87003D2A74
dialogue.line: You got what you deserved.

dialogue.speaker: D779D4AB4EC4B21B087FD0B0D8532760
dialogue.line: You had your reasons. But it's not enough.

dialogue.speaker: 1DDEECCF4A2F9EF6CAD44CAC57BD8F6E
dialogue.line: You said I'm to choose – choose what?

dialogue.speaker: 152F0B0044F6DFF4029B068D223A909C
dialogue.line: You're staying here.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Then why, pray tell, are you here?

dialogue.speaker: 116430D44ECED039DCC70392DECE08D5
dialogue.line: I need to sort something out still.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Onwards.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [scoffs] Coen, there's no killing all of them unless you flood the tunnels. Preferably with fire.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [scoff]

dialogue.speaker: 6D949188476E9EF1867E969905A8D464
dialogue.line: Drain him? That sounds... sick.

dialogue.speaker: D60D3E24447D2906BCDBFE94E27962A5
dialogue.line: Hit me with the truly awful.

dialogue.speaker: 1E216FE04AB41E9199705088BF4225C2
dialogue.line: I just wanted to see how he was.

dialogue.speaker: 159A42904EE04077DB5B04808EC1B437
dialogue.line: I need to prepare before we go.

dialogue.speaker: 4403E5184997567CA3BBF8ADEF7CD4D4
dialogue.line: I need to prepare before we go.

dialogue.speaker: 40E965F647F9B6BF1BD2B38C5100573F
dialogue.line: I'm not doing that.

dialogue.speaker: B95950EF4F58C5B5F4C3318F111C6DB2
dialogue.line: I've been there.

dialogue.speaker: D1FB09A34BC2DF6A09B988B140121B3B
dialogue.line: Memories, surface... What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: 4F4D1767467BC2AD86E924A3E29B2B8E
dialogue.line: The worse news - what's that about?

dialogue.speaker: 65B06D92408E7653CC99D3BC8A53C7C2
dialogue.line: Who was Isbrand to you?

dialogue.speaker: 3F01879748D19A19BBD660A6D0797CDA
dialogue.line: You're being dramatic.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: We're like mice here, scurrying round the edges... Trying not to wake up the cat.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Will it really be so bad?

dialogue.speaker: 927E64D743BA65BE9CDECAB5B2AC2A88
dialogue.line: It’s a weird thing to say, but I like it here.

dialogue.speaker: B1E63A3647DA840C5CA1DF9B9BA0A390
dialogue.line: This... this can't be real.

dialogue.speaker: 42CCE78345261CFA9DDBC592B41DF7CA
dialogue.line: Will it really be so bad?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You know what I mean. So... he was a Roman commander?

dialogue.speaker: 74CF5C5C463CCC499426E79D74856B80
dialogue.line: Did you know how he was turned?

dialogue.speaker: 7A5B4FC14FF881D6020EABBD603587F9
dialogue.line: How old even is he?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Well, this wasn't what we were after but... We're on the right track. It was a memory of Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: She made her choice; spat in the face of a man who ignored her protests. I commend her for it. It took strength I wish I'd had in the past.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're right. Considering he wrote it.

dialogue.speaker: A9EB5DC84FDBD2070EDE379F3EB8145E
dialogue.line: His wife deserved better.

dialogue.speaker: 2B798A1E489F5E2195A9D4B7DA41BF9A
dialogue.line: I enjoyed it too.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're hiding something.

dialogue.speaker: 5403F6B5489FE50CF84285A395E443D7
dialogue.line: All right, if you say so, let's skip it.

dialogue.speaker: 5141C8D84C7EA90A7690F994A9A35DF7
dialogue.line: All right, if you say so.

dialogue.speaker: 164420B24D9C05F2AA62BEA073613C25
dialogue.line: Alright, let's find another.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Those buildings there – let's head that way.

dialogue.speaker: 415BDC014026F45E4FF10588A4F82626
dialogue.line: No, I want to know what's there.

dialogue.speaker: AD5A29A6406631AB1104E9B72C70BF9C
dialogue.line: You're hiding something.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Would you listen to me for once? I said there's nothing in there we can use.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: I'd rather check it.

dialogue.speaker: B4E6B9074D6E96AE293643B3CA062575
dialogue.line: Fine, let's go the other way.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You care how I see you?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah. I appreciate it. This place looks like it's near the cathedral. We should check it out when we're back in our world.

dialogue.speaker: 930F6E7549A060D154343E8D4FD00341
dialogue.line: Can you tell me what it was?

dialogue.speaker: 01EB3472420CB27ACE3DA2A6AB9F2E9B
dialogue.line: I had no idea it would be that awful.

dialogue.speaker: 0A6568B34A21A4FF1F34A4BA01F1A629
dialogue.line: I needed to know what you were hiding.

dialogue.speaker: 14F715F44669016E58ADD8BB0B51C09E
dialogue.line: I thought you went on without me.

dialogue.speaker: 6831312F46B2F72BD24855A257616769
dialogue.line: I'm sorry for going there.

dialogue.speaker: 6DF601584EED472F73B5B3AAD993D3CD
dialogue.line: I'm still sorry.

dialogue.speaker: F31B31FB4D11A130EFF0B48D409D5EFE
dialogue.line: I'm still sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 8B5929FC44455BFE0F892D82C7E00C47
dialogue.line: What way was that?

dialogue.speaker: 410018BD4AC63A0AA9A4B987A8FB83A1
dialogue.line: Why did you get exiled?

dialogue.speaker: 69EDA6974BFB4B78BAF47E98B9AF97EF
dialogue.line: Why were you exiled?

dialogue.speaker: 93EED88443902B1005659F854D1DA8DC
dialogue.line: You care how I see you?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You should do it, Lacra. You've known him. It makes more sense.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [chuckles] Help? Coen, do you have any idea what that entails?

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You do? I don't-I don't know you, do I? The memory... I'm trying... I wish!

dialogue.speaker: 06FB5A5C4AA9CC7B6FB7018E6A937F09
dialogue.line: I can do it, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: B1526A654A084957757CC984BDA466AB
dialogue.line: I can invite him in, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: 9A53A62740FA7A649DE795ADC46E7A66
dialogue.line: I won't.

dialogue.speaker: 392CC81B43CD1F88D88B389585E3B66C
dialogue.line: I've invited a vrakhir in before.

dialogue.speaker: 43B9C63E4D8226A451795D9105F236E8
dialogue.line: It doesn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: 0C2D2CB74FA96CC17F7E73BFFFEA1681
dialogue.line: I’m sorry. You’ll stay here, forever.

dialogue.speaker: 7DD5F126435D75B9FBA142B113835272
dialogue.line: What does it entail?

dialogue.speaker: 9E4901A140CBDF754FBF4DACE887962D
dialogue.line: What does it entail?

dialogue.speaker: 610279EB4CE70DB8286582B4CFC1798B
dialogue.line: You should do it, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: 43B366CB42AAB263ECECFF8ED3149C84
dialogue.line: [say nothing]

dialogue.speaker: 7EABFF1A47B58D691BEBABB93F5F1F30
dialogue.line: [say nothing]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You should be glad I'm telling you anything at all.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're not telling me the whole truth.

dialogue.speaker: AD0992AF41A394752D6919B60A39803D
dialogue.line: Are you sure we're not too late?

dialogue.speaker: FA6DFEA1428C7532AE977CABD443A119
dialogue.line: Exhausted and in dire need of a nap.

dialogue.speaker: A73044EB4E241E76352188A5437B13CE
dialogue.line: Should something feel wrong?

dialogue.speaker: F74A6023439BA8D1E6C27295B2B40764
dialogue.line: What is the goal of the ritual?

dialogue.speaker: 8CD5372C49ABBB087629DB9704003D04
dialogue.line: Who are the Augurs?

dialogue.speaker: 0F383D344EFB8924DF0F0988A7C28D67
dialogue.line: Why did he exile you?

dialogue.speaker: 624786C34C9BFA7854B196BADBFC4668
dialogue.line: You got over Isbrand's fate quickly.

dialogue.speaker: FD9466DE41D328F159B7119ADEEB53F7
dialogue.line: You seem surprisingly relaxed.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.104_soldier_01
dialogue.line: We need to run!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You'll see far worse. Better get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What? Whose voices are those?

dialogue.speaker: Young_Brencis
dialogue.line: You will do what I say, or I’ll cut you down for mutiny. Octavius!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.104_soldier_02
dialogue.line: [sigh] Sire… It’s been two days. We can’t –

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.104_guard_01
dialogue.line: You're – what are you?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: We're getting close.

dialogue.speaker: Young_Brencis
dialogue.line: It is me. Stand aside, I'm going to see my wife.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Is that so.

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: This is a terrible idea. Must you insist on learning it the hard way?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.104_guard_02
dialogue.line: No. That's not him.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Brencis_Wife
dialogue.line: Wh-what is happening?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Trust me on this.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What was this for?

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You think you can control it?! Hubris, do you know what that is?

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: [chant]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.NoName_Lacra
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You were right, they never stop.

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You did not try that again...

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Snap out of it, you fool!

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You will not control it, Brencis. This is hubris!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why did he attack us?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You'd be one of them – the likho. Clinging to a promise of life and dying over and over in a cursed cycle, trying to grasp at the illusion.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You! Calling yourself a man of honour!

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: I will hear none of this!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yeah. I... don't know what comes next.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301_1st_soldier02
dialogue.line: What – what happened? What's going on here?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q301_Prisoner01
dialogue.line: Oh God. I... I, yes, they passed by here, but I don't know where they were going.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [scoff] Good job cleaning him up ahead of time.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q301_Prisoner02
dialogue.line: They'll take me first. Then they'll come for you.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301_1st_soldier01
dialogue.line: What are those voices? Who's talking?! Show yourself!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're tense.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Well, you keep thinking that, and let's hope your confidence is enough.

dialogue.speaker: F9B08DB84ADD090EC75577AF15CF2CED
dialogue.line: I have to.

dialogue.speaker: EC9A6AF04D87648CEAEFFCABDB05D487
dialogue.line: No, I'm a ball of nerves, too.

dialogue.speaker: A5FCE2F54420C06654643C80284C00A6
dialogue.line: What did you want to say?

dialogue.speaker: 4AD653864530AAE1DF17BB99259A5531
dialogue.line: You're tense.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Stop wondering and start moving.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Oh, yeah. There's a draught coming through the rubble...

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah. Off you go.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yet it seems to have survived a fire.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301_1st_soldier02
dialogue.line: Stop them! They mustn't get to the sanctum!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301_1st_soldier01
dialogue.line: Who the fuck are you? How did you get in?

dialogue.speaker: Ambrus
dialogue.line: You sound very sure of yourself, Coen of Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You've no idea what's going on here. What your sire's dragged you into.

dialogue.speaker: 93EC025640BFE39A49B85298859989C6
dialogue.line: Brencis's rule won't last forever.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Where is my family? Where does he keep them?!

dialogue.speaker: A314861B4B00C80C5E03E28D1DC9AD7E
dialogue.line: Duels are for men of honour - and you have none.

dialogue.speaker: A22852C94E2D43B5ECCD4C90CE57EBFC
dialogue.line: I don't walk into traps willingly.

dialogue.speaker: 531F70134E0F710972A358853DFFFFF8
dialogue.line: What is this thing?

dialogue.speaker: 4BF0639E445DC7A7C91422B10D349FAB
dialogue.line: Where is my family?

dialogue.speaker: ED80415D4DBB829C50E533A1DC062250
dialogue.line: Where is your master now?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Good. It's tiring. I'd rather save my strength for now.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: There we go.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301.necrospeak_corpse_04
dialogue.line: [screams]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yes, yes, fascinating. Let's see if they know anything useful.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301.necrospeak_corpse_03
dialogue.line: [screams]

dialogue.speaker: F33BBF8A4F0CB611DC8D0187B78B5B29
dialogue.line: I think we fucked up.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What the fuck?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301.necrospeak_corpse_05
dialogue.line: Those ones! From this cell! Knyaz wants them in the throneroom!

dialogue.speaker: ECA45A2B4F0888086E12489A5CAD835F
dialogue.line: We have to go. Right now!

dialogue.speaker: Bakir
dialogue.line: Spectacular, isn't it?! The sights, the smells! And those sweet words of His...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why was my family taken to the throneroom?!

dialogue.speaker: 34821F124D4B4048978980BA396ED7D1
dialogue.line: What are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: AFA882B54DAE1EB12F7DFAA06E0614DB
dialogue.line: Where is Brencis?!

dialogue.speaker: 0A3044C64AB3DC769A62D69B922FF1CD
dialogue.line: Why was my family taken to the throneroom?!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You're talking to a madman, Coen. We don't have time for this. Fun ends here, Bakir!

dialogue.speaker: TheHive
dialogue.line: More vrakhiri?! Not with Brencis! No, no! Kill!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Your soul's doomed. At least make something of it...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301_1st_soldier02
dialogue.line: [screams]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.301_1st_soldier01
dialogue.line: What-what is this?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: It wasn't good or bad, it was necessary. Come on, we need to get to Brencis himself.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Lacra. Are you sure this was a good idea?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: What if Brencis had a contingency plan – if he forced the ritual to be completed right as we attacked? No.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [sigh]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You were right. She did keep her word.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're right. We don't have time to talk.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Your family or potentially thousands of lives? Sorry. The choice was clear.

dialogue.speaker: E2C280614AC60866D84C0C8F123AB6C5
dialogue.line: I don't want to see you again after this.

dialogue.speaker: 066B6A154D3ADD845D48418C03F2B835
dialogue.line: I suppose. I would've stopped you.

dialogue.speaker: 970B8F8B4C4DE0F663C9B09833FF3E72
dialogue.line: I'd kill you if I didn't need you.

dialogue.speaker: 04363D8D470F9BA32C8204901437629B
dialogue.line: I'll never forgive you this.

dialogue.speaker: 9C8E27FE458F686018CABF8BD88FBDEC
dialogue.line: It's worth nothing.

dialogue.speaker: D051A96C4A667C0BA7E12E8B66C3B437
dialogue.line: Nevermind. Let's just get to Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 6CE280F8403D0BF1571C669AEE30948E
dialogue.line: We should've freed everyone first!

dialogue.speaker: 2E459D85465DDB0147B74CB1CE17B9D0
dialogue.line: Yeah, we've wasted enough time.

dialogue.speaker: B3210B3D46B44EEEBD3B1BBE3DD14F75
dialogue.line: Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: Xante
dialogue.line: You should hurry. By now, Brencis is well aware that you're coming.

dialogue.speaker: EE70F8974053F79D77D324A218BB2C64
dialogue.line: Her superiors? Who are they?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You do not need to.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You wanted to get rid of me? Try it.

dialogue.speaker: 322AE1DC4E3F5B042D9212B782472B48
dialogue.line: What does Brencis want with my family?

dialogue.speaker: 9386B5A2436F894639ABACA1B3F13E0F
dialogue.line: What does Brencis want with my family?

dialogue.speaker: DFD3EE0B4433395F333E40976589C876
dialogue.line: Where is Brencis right now?

dialogue.speaker: E60C663A49D661528391ADA846F833FA
dialogue.line: Which way is Brencis's throneroom?

dialogue.speaker: 0D7FDF4043EC185DE993898209F66059
dialogue.line: Why would you risk it if you don't care?

dialogue.speaker: 5593611F4BB68043ECEB448659612B17
dialogue.line: You wanted to get rid of me? Try it.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: It better be the way out of this shit.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [Coen jumps in. Lacra follows.]

dialogue.speaker: Xante
dialogue.line: You think you’ve seen darkness? Just wait. The truth has yet to unfold.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You'd leave me for some yokels?

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: You'll waste away, meld, and bemoan your existence. I won't.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You think I'd betray her, just like that?

dialogue.speaker: B22D90DB421DC9A6C6EBCAB66DA2ABE5
dialogue.line: I accept the offer. I'm sorry, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: C3C03B5140560E7BDCC7C8A7D6F10BB3
dialogue.line: I accept the offer. I'm sorry, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: F2BB2B5F4D811CDA6E61C8B80EA30736
dialogue.line: I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: E2078FBA4D2BCDC9EC6C80B60B606118
dialogue.line: I've heard enough.

dialogue.speaker: 4DB7ADCD4BFEFDA7F3A306ADFE09F005
dialogue.line: Lacra, can you handle him on your own?

dialogue.speaker: 51891C6C4F82CCADF649A69938589458
dialogue.line: Lacra, can you handle him on your own?

dialogue.speaker: BECCD88A4B0807C43BB1989FFF8BA28A
dialogue.line: No. We fight Brencis together.

dialogue.speaker: 1525509C4841F76BD13E7FA0F941E755
dialogue.line: They? Who is he talking about?

dialogue.speaker: 3F58909A41D2C5A0ECCADDBEAF933949
dialogue.line: What makes you think I'd betray her?

dialogue.speaker: 508E5F49467E8C194658D499F78F752D
dialogue.line: What makes you think I'd betray her?

dialogue.speaker: D20EEB5F4D843C06263D4CA3A5BC877B
dialogue.line: What were you trying to achieve, Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: BD1D993240E1D5291673199348399E42
dialogue.line: What? You'll set them free, leave me alone - just like that?

dialogue.speaker: 08427010492488C7A25CF7817A6A69D8
dialogue.line: What? You're setting them free and letting me go, just like that?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What is Brencis trying to do here? What did he want to happen?

dialogue.speaker: Ambrus
dialogue.line: Well, what are you waiting for? An invitation?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Ten years as a vrakhir, I gave you? Well, that was generous...

dialogue.speaker: Bakir
dialogue.line: You think this is how this ends?! Fools! Idiots!

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: I can't wait to watch your corpse turn to a pile of dirt.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Which way is his throneroom?! Tell me!

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: You're still holding a grudge? Oh, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: I've been looking forward to this, Brencis. I've wanted to see you squirm for so long.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Your death is the only one I choose.

dialogue.speaker: Xanthe
dialogue.line: This mustn't be. It mustn't!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: I'll get to that throneroom over your dead body, you evil bitch.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You've grown complacent, Xanthe. Slow.

sq717_12_TransitionToSwamp: We're close. There should be a little shrine nearby. Keep an eye out for it.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: So this Kallias, he lived somewhere around here?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yes, if the legends are true. Centuries ago.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You want to talk about feelings?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [snort] I've always dreamt of freedom, I constantly wonder what it feels like. Because I wouldn't know.

sq717_16_first_comment: [inhale] Over there, see? They're around us. Waiting for something fun to happen.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: You didn't think it'd be that easy, did you?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: So the game is catch? Fine. I've had training.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What is this thing?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Really looks ancient. Might've been drawn with his own hand.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Your only role?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh] This is the worst adventure possible. Why are we doing this again?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah, but we'll continue to do so, pissed off or not. So hey.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Shit, it's gone.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: This is a priest's signet ring. Could it be... no.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah. Psoglav's work. They're not after your flesh... at first.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [sigh] Fine. Whatever.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You sure this pain is worth it?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: And what the hell is this?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Huh, looks suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah. Looks like it's some kind of tomb.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: These... plants. I don't like the look of them.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Could it get any worse?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: I'm willing to bet something will decide to ruin our night soon enough.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: So long as we find what we're looking for...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're missing out on some interesting flavours.

sq717_67_lacra_venting_tomb: Stop huffing corpse dust, Coen, it's a waste of time.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: This wall, it seems different. Newer, perhaps?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: No, fuck this. I've had enough staring at walls.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [nod]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [sigh] Fine. I'll offer one more – but it's the last one.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Xanthe? She and Kallias knew each other?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Wonderful.

sq717_76_lacra_calling_over: Coen! Come over here, right this moment!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [eat the mandrake]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [inhales] Really? You? Colour me surprised. Heh.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Your sense of duty is...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [kiss her]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: [huff] Same as before – more mud in our boots.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're asking that here? Right now? In the middle of... all of this?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: I mean, go ahead, I wouldn't mind a snack, even if they don't like it.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [snort] I don’t recommend it. Last time Brencis did that he nearly burned his face off.

cs_sq714_01_vicho_start: See my transgressions and sins, and if it be your will, deliver swift justice upon me. Amen.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Over a hundred years trying to escape my fate. It ends now.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Thank you, Vicho. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Your two-coloured eyes, my friend. That and the hunger in them, which you can barely hide. They tell me much about your nature.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're not a typical vrakhir.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: You are not from Svartrau, are you?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You have some connections to the Jewish community?

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: [exhale] Now I'll never know.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're right, it's still quite fresh.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yeah... You don't have to tell me...

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Yes. But there's plenty of blood in other parts of the building...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Right. I'll join you when I'm finished.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Please, focus.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier02
dialogue.line: Who the hell are you two, and what were you doing poking around that house?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier01
dialogue.line: You better listen to your friend, old man. Unless you both want to spend a few days in a cell.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: What? You guards are obviously –

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: – doing their job. And we don't want to bother them any longer. Please.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: ...and you're just gonna leave them there?!

dialogue.speaker: 714_Soldier03
dialogue.line: We're on patrol right now. We don't have the time to play gravediggers.

dialogue.speaker: 714_Soldier02
dialogue.line: Yeah, that's exactly what we're going to do.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Yes... Thank you for that, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're the one who drew their attention! They'd have marched on if you'd just kept quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: [sigh] He was a good friend of mine. We travelled together around Europe decades ago.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You think the doctor might be involved somehow?

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: They're gone. What is it that you want to ask me?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Right. So... how old are you, exactly?

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Temperamental, to be honest. Don't get me wrong, he's a good friend. And a good doctor, too - his mind is simply brilliant.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why did he do that?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Ugh. What are those?

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Yes. Mine. Simeon extracted them for me.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: I'll take a look around, maybe he left a note or something.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Simeon? Are you in here? Hm. Nothing.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What's this document? Looks very official.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Yes, I know the man. Simeon dresses his wounds when he inevitably hurts himself in the smithy. [chuckle]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why would he need a warehouse?

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Still, it's worth seeking out. I recall there being a large building near the blacksmith's. Could be that warehouse.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What now?

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: The door's barred shut.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: That's... unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: You could be right. If he did experiment, then to what outcome?

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: I'm sorry, old friend...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Vicho, I need your help!

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: You're right, of course. But please, don't judge poor Simeon too harshly. He was a good man, despite his flaws.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're to blame as well.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: Where others see darkness and fear, I see the world finally stopping its everlasting motion.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're doing the right thing. The sun will purify your sins.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh] If that is your choice – I can't stop you.

dialogue.speaker: Vicho
dialogue.line: [sigh] I don't know, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: Young_Brencis
dialogue.line: What are you?

dialogue.line: You should’ve listened.

dialogue.line: You’re my wife. You’re coming with me.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Brencis_Wife
dialogue.line: [screams]

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: The world won’t bend to your will and neither will the flames.

dialogue.line: You must learn to obey the rules. Or next time, this will be you.

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: …No, just kill me at least!

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: Silence now.

dialogue.line: You don’t understand that things have changed.

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: …no. You didn’t.

dialogue.line: You should do it, Lacra. You've known him. It makes more sense.

dialogue.line: [chuckles] Help? Coen, do you have any idea what that entails?

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand

dialogue.speaker: 06FB5A5C4AA9CC7B6FB7018E6A937F09
dialogue.line: I can do it, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: B1526A654A084957757CC984BDA466AB
dialogue.line: I can invite him in, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: 9A53A62740FA7A649DE795ADC46E7A66
dialogue.line: I won't.

dialogue.speaker: 392CC81B43CD1F88D88B389585E3B66C
dialogue.line: I've invited a vrakhir in before.

dialogue.speaker: 43B9C63E4D8226A451795D9105F236E8
dialogue.line: It doesn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: 0C2D2CB74FA96CC17F7E73BFFFEA1681
dialogue.line: I’m sorry. You’ll stay here, forever.

dialogue.speaker: 7DD5F126435D75B9FBA142B113835272
dialogue.line: What does it entail?

dialogue.speaker: 9E4901A140CBDF754FBF4DACE887962D
dialogue.line: What does it entail?

dialogue.speaker: 610279EB4CE70DB8286582B4CFC1798B
dialogue.line: You should do it, Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: 43B366CB42AAB263ECECFF8ED3149C84
dialogue.line: [say nothing]

dialogue.speaker: 7EABFF1A47B58D691BEBABB93F5F1F30
dialogue.line: [say nothing]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.104_guard_01
dialogue.line: You're – what are you?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: We're getting close.

dialogue.speaker: Young_Brencis
dialogue.line: It is me. Stand aside, I'm going to see my wife.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Is that so.

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: This is a terrible idea. Must you insist on learning it the hard way?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.104_guard_02
dialogue.line: No. That's not him.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Brencis_Wife
dialogue.line: Wh-what is happening?

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Trust me on this.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What was this for?

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You think you can control it?! Hubris, do you know what that is?

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: [chant]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.NoName_Lacra
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You were right, they never stop.

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You did not try that again...

dialogue.speaker: Lacra
dialogue.line: Snap out of it, you fool!

dialogue.speaker: Isbrand
dialogue.line: You will not control it, Brencis. This is hubris!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Why did he attack us?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.line: Yes, Coen? What brings you here?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You’re a witch.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: This will hurt.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What's going on, Anca?! I was alright! I was human!

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: Yes. And then the sun set.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: Look! Hey, it's me – Anca! I'm back and –

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Careful!

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: Coen! This way!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What the fuck?!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're bleeding, we –

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: [sobs]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [chuckle] Sod the books.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: [laugh]

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: You can breathe, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What? How did it – all on its own?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Wait, what?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: You mean right now? No, I'm afraid not. There's no time.

dialogue.line: Is there anything you could do to help now?

dialogue.speaker: 739C8DFD41F488FF83C8BE93A88B7414
dialogue.line: My mother's unwell – can you help?

dialogue.speaker: CEC31E9C42868779F3EDB993919C349E
dialogue.line: So I can come see you even when I'm not running errands?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: The prioress obsessed over cleanliness. Checked our nails one by one, and if she found any dirt, you'd spend the rest of the day kneeling on gravel.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [keep on looking]

dialogue.speaker: 7B5AB9824F7C5591636910B24B9718BB
dialogue.line: All of this – it feels hopeless.

dialogue.speaker: 3F7B8D134629AE578EB72DAF50C86BC8
dialogue.line: Anca...?

dialogue.speaker: 4651F1B948E69340ABA4C9815B909872
dialogue.line: Hope I'm not interrupting anything...?

dialogue.speaker: EE240BDC4699BCA13FFE548B90A1F9BF
dialogue.line: I'm all right.

dialogue.speaker: F155D3CE46BED4B46ECEB8A0349785D0
dialogue.line: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have asked.

dialogue.speaker: 21CB32E04347BBB1A5034BB2460843EF
dialogue.line: That doesn't explain the bloody scars.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: Your words – they might bring her back, if only for a spell.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You know things are tight for us.

dialogue.speaker: 3E471DEE4944228330B1DE81A979AF11
dialogue.line: I really have to go.

dialogue.speaker: 8479AC4C45DB31220615129F73631163
dialogue.line: Sorry – can't afford it.

dialogue.speaker: 21F9E59C4D73C25DD05C11B5C4033CE3
dialogue.line: What if she doesn't want to drink the infusion?

dialogue.speaker: F9B2273A449D8B2DD0AA269195A035E1
dialogue.line: What were you doing earlier? By the river?

dialogue.speaker: AD3E03F44B948BC813B20D9C23F67090
dialogue.line: Why doesn't the vrakhir blood cure her?

dialogue.speaker: 222EFF25462ADA3FEC204E81B80A4BF7
dialogue.line: You know things are tight for us right now.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: It's no wonder. There's no getting used to some things.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: On edge. Mass... It just makes people nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: Your wounds – they're barely closed. You should rest some more.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Would you, in my place?

dialogue.speaker: DD315181404D07B6950D14BD1A34E429
dialogue.line: How am I even alive?

dialogue.speaker: 813968CD44403FBA52CD21A411453E06
dialogue.line: I need to go back to Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: 5E4C25CE4BD88470411BB6AB070762C9
dialogue.line: I'm so glad nothing happened to you.

dialogue.speaker: 4B7B792A4AD784BDBEA882969775CC30
dialogue.line: Noted.

dialogue.speaker: DBDED54448D1741ECE6EB78CEC41CB85
dialogue.line: What are you saying?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What's that? Crows?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: You'll get your answers. I can promise you that.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Time for what? Despair?!

dialogue.speaker: D86C0E7A488BA13AF194E687CB30678F
dialogue.line: Again...?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: You just will – you'll see. Sometimes it's a personal item, sometimes it's what their eyes rested on as they passed away.

dialogue.speaker: 4C61183C4A3978BBFDBC3D9E2BE694AF
dialogue.line: Brencis plans to drain them all!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q101_swtd_soldier
dialogue.line: Your big brother will come save you? Oh, wish it were true.

dialogue.speaker: F92C1D584ED511310CC8CF87557A8581
dialogue.line: How did you learn all of this?

dialogue.speaker: 8005D7FC450777665B48CA82BC703847
dialogue.line: Never mind. No point asking 'what if'.

dialogue.speaker: 7251DBDB4D79EC683EC965811B7C5654
dialogue.line: This is disgusting!

dialogue.speaker: 0F91C2BC4A3A0858182A7FB01BF54EDA
dialogue.line: [attempt to compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: 769E70B948978C33547745B4B856FAAC
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: DC90CEEB40B21C5B1B3476AF8D4EE284
dialogue.line: [make another attempt to compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What if they're dead? What if I find their bodies in the rubble?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: Things weren't fine before. We were being bled by a monster, week after week, living in constant fear.

dialogue.speaker: 303974F74D4E71AC7C71C485CEA48DC0
dialogue.line: Just yesterday, everything was fine...

dialogue.speaker: A84F16D143DE2CD5CD2A11A0F4ADC39C
dialogue.line: Look out for yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 73F2CEAD40F75398E6E08FB784BCF6D8
dialogue.line: Look – the gates lay in rubble.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: Yes. So we shouldn't expect anyone to welcome us.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: This fog... It's thick as milk.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Where?! In the Svartrau dungeons? The Tantari watchtower? In that guardpost near Parlita?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: You can ask around. Someone must've seen the transport.

dialogue.speaker: 7F8D66474C2FF7563451FDB92EDB1557
dialogue.line: Well, what is it?

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: We'd better watch our backs, then.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Let's see...

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You're not serious.

dialogue.speaker: Anca
dialogue.line: You'd do anything to learn about the fate of your family, correct? Anything at all?

dialogue.speaker: F12F38AE4F8DF2C32F317EB9A8F1C6B5
dialogue.line: What are you going to do to me?

dialogue.speaker: 7CD1DAC546F238C37369618145EC077A

dialogue.line: Just a sip.

dialogue.line: This is sick.

dialogue.line: Yes, he drinks our blood, and we drink his. We nourish Brencis, and he protects us from harm.

dialogue.line: May it forever endure.

dialogue.speaker: Pieter
dialogue.line: Shhh. We don't want to attract attention.

dialogue.line: [remain silent]

q300_11_gmpl_ghost_esme: Nowhere's safe. Nowhere! We'll die. We'll all die!!!

dialogue.speaker: Esme
dialogue.line: [scoff] What sort of a question is that?

dialogue.speaker: Yanna
dialogue.line: You're forgetting something.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Your olatki. Your smile. Your voice.

dialogue.speaker: Mirto
dialogue.line: Huh, dumb one!

dialogue.speaker: Lunka
dialogue.line: Please!

dialogue.speaker: Pieter
dialogue.line: Run? Where to? What are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You were supposed to be there for us. For me!

dialogue.speaker: Esme
dialogue.line: With all this? With what happened that winter?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Who are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: Pieter
dialogue.line: Why is he not with you?!

dialogue.speaker: Esme
dialogue.line: Where is he?!

dialogue.speaker: Mirto
dialogue.line: I'm just as strong as dad! Only shorter!

dialogue.speaker: Esme
dialogue.line: Where are those two? Always sleeping in...

dialogue.speaker: Yanna
dialogue.line: No! Don't touch me!

dialogue.speaker: Lunka
dialogue.line: I'll eat and eat and eat until I'm as big as Coen!

dialogue.speaker: Pieter
dialogue.line: Get a move on! Idle hands are the devil's workshop!

dialogue.speaker: CC821F6744C24604C75C4796FB2A5D56
dialogue.line: A clan of people who lived amongst the wolves... and were able to change their shape.

dialogue.speaker: A20DCE36437DCEF12706D88D30407001
dialogue.line: A hidden cave...

dialogue.speaker: DB2DF8064DDBF1F0F95C3590F8E034E2
dialogue.line: A whole clan of... people lived here some time ago.

dialogue.speaker: 21C167C94C72758EFA1CFE9854454589
dialogue.line: And a pack of wolves. Shit.

dialogue.speaker: 3AE106DF4703148BC0A5FFB145C81FFE
dialogue.line: And really hated the vrakhiri.

dialogue.speaker: 4BF398C44E4A1CB31D080EBC10058BF2
dialogue.line: Blood... Hm. The trail leads deeper into the forest....

dialogue.speaker: 8DFBAD4647B1E42EBF852CBB3FAA2110
dialogue.line: But those wounds... they don't look like wolves's work. No bite marks...

dialogue.speaker: B91FDDD44A2C10B2CDE5809A7CAAE74E
dialogue.line: Fuck... Well, at least I fared much better than these soldiers...

dialogue.speaker: F44B43624906F1C00898E48E2A16A07D
dialogue.line: God... How many other monstrosities are hiding in the dark?

dialogue.speaker: 2FC2250A477546EE30AC4F83D68B7C91
dialogue.line: Hm. Judging by his armour, he was one of Bakir's men.

dialogue.speaker: DDA792184EBA947B1A149C9B0128705B
dialogue.line: I have no idea what those mean. Some pagan symbols, maybe?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.line: Jesus...

dialogue.speaker: 854EBB1440E8BCD7938885835B47C78F
dialogue.line: Looks like they left this one behind, to keep them informed about the situation in the valley.

dialogue.speaker: FF4C1F5B4C79AA57A59A91972707B2C8
dialogue.line: Lots of clothing. Weird – most of it looks sewn together from rags.

dialogue.speaker: EEC0948E422EBC37EFBEAF8B56C22999
dialogue.line: So it was Bakir's hunting party. But what is this 'monster' they were pursuing?

dialogue.speaker: 479CE1BC4E22129155DF719113CA85A6
dialogue.line: Someone really wanted this guy dead.

dialogue.speaker: 290D9DF34F71444EC25B6BA313A2DF32
dialogue.line: Something really messed him up...

dialogue.speaker: A7F50B22400060FD013024A599CA24FA
dialogue.line: The pawprint trail ends here and changes into... footprints? What the hell is going on here?

dialogue.speaker: 744F19C04C68EACE1D689A8EB86543A6
dialogue.line: They're full of various herbs. Anca used plants like these to make medicine.

dialogue.speaker: 8632561E4FCED9B0A57B0BB88CEB1927
dialogue.line: This paw is huge... I've never seen a wolf this big.

dialogue.speaker: A930B5DD4873D76BB29707B8EC28A5DF
dialogue.line: What kind of animal was strong enough to leave claw marks on a rock?

dialogue.speaker: B80F1F4C43E6604C0C75D89A45908E02
dialogue.line: Whatever this man was... Seems like he cared about his people.

dialogue.speaker: 22A004604F4870ACECE9B4A66A5AF5B3
dialogue.line: Whoever shot this arrow, hit something. But where's the hunter? And their prey?
